title: Tmux Omni Configuration
description: Configuration schema for tmux-omni leader menu and command palette

$schema.description: URL or relative path to this JSON Schema file

title.description: Title displayed at the top of the leader menu popup

items.description: List of top-level menu groups or action items

key.description: Single hotkey character or key name pressed to trigger this item (e.g. 'p', 'w', '?', ':', 'C-s', 'M-1')

title.description: Display title of the item or submenu

icon.description: Nerd Font icon glyph displayed next to the item (e.g. '󰓦', '󰖲', '󰋜', '󰅍', '󰒍', '󰊢', '󰧑', '󰆍', '󰏖', '󰘳')

description.description: Short explanation of what this action does or what the submenu contains

action.description: Command to execute when selected. Used only for leaf actions (omitted if 'items' is present).

target.description:
Execution container:
- 'tmux': Runs command directly in tmux server (e.g. 'select-pane -L', 'new-window')
- 'popup': Runs interactive TUI/command in a floating tmux popup
- 'popup-shell': Runs command in a popup and keeps shell open after command exits
- 'send': Types command text directly into the active pane prompt without executing
- 'split-v': Runs command in a new bottom vertical split pane
- 'split-h': Runs command in a new right-hand horizontal split pane
- 'window': Runs command in a new dedicated tmux window

popup_width.description: Width of the popup window when target is 'popup' or 'popup-shell' (e.g. '80%', '70%', '100')

popup_height.description: Height of the popup window when target is 'popup' or 'popup-shell' (e.g. '75%', '65%', '30')

persist_shell.description: If true, keeps shell open even if command succeeds with exit code 0

items.description: Nested array of menu items if this entry is a subgroup
